body.purpose: Style.font.family and the shared type scale in panel and bar.

native.measurementConvention: Style.space(n) resolves native shell scaling; values are not a CSS pixel scale.
native.previewSupport: Native component metadata only. No HTML/CSS surrogate gallery or synthesized tonal ramps.

colorFunctions.mix: Linear interpolation of the Qt.color RGB channels, with alpha 1.
colorFunctions.legible: Mix ink toward foreground in 0.1 steps, returning the first candidate with calculated sRGB contrast >= 4.65 against the supplied background; fall back to foreground.

native.panelOwnership: KeyboardPanel owns appearance, border, corner radius, padding, positioning, focus, dismissal and transitions. No internal-card overrides.

components.name: Weekly bar summary
components.description: Selected monochrome provider marks and weekly percentages, with a plain gap and no divider. A native Headroom label remains when no provider is shown in the bar.

components.name: Cost period selector
components.description: Native bordered buttons for Today, Yesterday and 30 Days, with accessible tab names and selection. Pointer, arrows and keys 1-3 select the period.

components.name: Cost ring and legend
components.description: Canvas ring with the two frontmatter cost colors, a rounded whole-dollar total and USD label, plus named legend entries with exact two-decimal amounts. Missing totals leave the ring neutral.

components.name: Provider quota group
components.description: Flat provider section with monochrome heading, quota rows, conditional warnings and theme meters; sections use native separators.
states: calm forecast: theme-accent fill, no note or marker, hover projection
caution forecast: yellow fill and pace marker, amber hourglass and dim normal-weight spare note
urgent: urgency fill and flame, pace marker, dim normal-weight ETA when available
exhausted: urgency fill and flame, Limit reached, no marker
fresh without projection: absolute usage bands at 80% and 90%, no note or marker
stale: status, fill opacity 0.4 and no forecast
missing or expired: em dash and empty meter

components.name: Settings, Refresh and status footer
components.description: Native bordered buttons with gear and refresh glyphs beside text; status identifies refresh activity and synthetic data.

components.name: Provider settings
components.description: Native provider enable and top-bar switches, reorder arrows, cost toggle and Done. Saved preferences apply immediately; disabled providers retain the top-bar choice.

narrative.overview: A native Omarchy panel: flat theme surfaces, standard border and corners, shared fonts and controls, monochrome marks and theme-accent allowance meters.
keyCharacteristics: Flat sections and native popup border, corner radius, typography and control states.
Strong headings and amounts, subdued supporting text.
Provider color confined to the cost split; shared theme accent for healthy allowance, yellow and red for warnings.
Explicit text for unavailable readings, resets, and forecast warnings.

rules.name: The Separate Roles Rule
rules.body: Cost colors identify providers. Quota color communicates capacity state; the fill length always measures remaining allowance. Warning labels use secondary text.

dos: Do keep theme colors and `Style.space()` expressions live.
Do retain text, units, and accessible names alongside charts, colors, and icons.
Do distinguish missing, stale, expired, and zero readings.
Do preserve the native panel lifecycle and keyboard controls.
Do use synthetic data and identify it in previews.
donts: Don't hardcode the captured blue accent or a captured light/dark palette.
Don't use cost colors to tint provider quota groups or add permanent healthy forecast text.
Don't add provider tabs, Extra Usage, or Usage Trend sections to this widget.
Don't put every quota row in a separate card or add decorative animation.
